entries.title: Ask HN: Who's Hiring?
entries.author: mrduncan
entries.excerpt: I noticed a few threads with people saying that their company is hiring and it's been about a month since the last one of these (so I'm sure needs have changed). As a reminder, please include the location if you would need employees to work on-site.

entries.title: Tell HN: Threads fast
entries.author: pg
entries.excerpt: I just rewrote the code that generates the threads page to be faster. It used to be slow the first time you called it after a restart because it had to load lot of items into memory. Now items aren't loaded till the moment they're needed. This also makes it possible to show an unlimited number of threads.
entries.guide_zh: HN 重写 threads 页面生成逻辑，希望改善重启后首次访问缓慢。

entries.title: Ask HN: Are you an information addict?
entries.author: ghotli
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are you an information addict?
entries.excerpt: Do you check your phone too much? HN? Digg? Your email? Are there things you really need to do rather than sit here and read HN? What are you doing to deal with this?
entries.guide_zh: 频繁刷手机、新闻和邮件算信息成瘾吗，大家如何减少这种干扰？
